entries.title: Genesis 4:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The birth, occupation, and offering of Cain and Abel. 8 Cain murders his brother Abel. 11 The curse of Cain. 17 Has a son called Enoch, and builds a city, which he calls after his name. 18 His descendants, with Lamech and his two wives. 25 The birth of Seth, 26 and Enos.

knew. Nu 31:17 Cain.That is, gotten or acquired.

I have. 25; 3:15; 5:29; 1Jo 3:12

entries.title: Genesis 4:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
A.M. 129. B.C. 3875. in process of time. Heb. at the end ofdays. Either at the end of the year, or of the week, i.e., on the Sabbath.

1Ki 17:7; Ne 13:6 the fruit. Le 2:1-11; Nu 18:12

entries.content: the firstlings. Ex 13:12; Nu 18:12,17; Pr 3:9; Heb 9:22; 1Pe 1:19,20; Re 13:8 flock. Heb. sheep, or, goats. fat. Le 3:16,17 had. 15:17; Le 9:24; Nu 16:35; Jud 6:21; 1Ki 18:24,38; 1Ch 21:26 2Ch 7:1; Ps 20:3; *marg: Heb 11:4

entries.title: Genesis 4:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
My punishment is greater than I can bear. or, Mine iniquity is greater than that it may be forgiven.

Job 15:22; Re 16:9,11,21

entries.title: Genesis 4:15
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
Therefore. 1Ki 16:7; Ps 59:11; Ho 1:4; Mt 26:52 sevenfold. 24; Le 26:18,21,24,28; Ps 79:12; Pr 6:31 set a mark, etc.Or, rather, "gave a sign or token to Cain, that those who found him should not kill him."

Eze 9:4,6; Re 14:9,11

entries.title: Genesis 4:16
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: went. 14; 3:8; Ex 20:18; 2Ki 13:23; 24:20; Job 1:12; 2:7; 20:17; Ps 5:11 Ps 68:2; Jer 23:39; 52:3; Joh 1:3,10; Mt 18:20; Lu 13:26; 1Th 1:9 Nod.So called from {nad,} "a vagabond," which Cain is termed in ver. 12.
